platform.label: Introducing TickOck
platform.headline: Your complete event ticketing platform. Create, manage, and sell out in minutes.

stats.headline: We're building a better way to sell tickets. Create your account today and see the difference.
stats.subtitle: Whether you're organizing a massive food expo in your city, a live comedy night at a coffee shop, or an online masterclass from your living room, we take the hassle out of ticketing.

firstTimers.title: First-timers
firstTimers.desc: Create your event page, sell tickets in minutes, and get 24/7 support.

eventPros.title: Event pros
eventPros.desc: Powerful event features. Unbeatable prices. 99.9% uptime guaranteed.

freeEvents.title: Free events
freeEvents.desc: Hosting a free event? Sell tickets for zero cost, with full features included.

developers.title: Developers
developers.desc: Connect your event apps with our powerful API and ready-made integrations.

charities.title: Charities
charities.desc: Special pricing for charity events. Keep more of what you raise.

attractions.title: Attractions
attractions.desc: Timed entry management. Free event check-in app. Perfect for venues.

fees.headline: We believe your revenue belongs to you. That's why we keep our fees lower than major ticketing sites, so you can reinvest in your next big event.

howItWorks.label: Step by step
howItWorks.headline: The smarter way to run your next event.

feature1.title: Incredible events at your fingertips
feature1.desc: Whether you hate dealing with tech or love diving into the details, we've built the ultimate hassle-free ticketing platform. Go from creating an event to selling your first ticket in minutes.
feature1.bullet1: Launch your event page in minutes with our easy builder
feature1.bullet2: Accept online payments or manual bank transfers
feature1.bullet3: Set ticket tiers, limits, and cancellation policies

feature2.title: Sell out fast and keep more of your revenue
feature2.desc: Track your growth from ticket number one to a packed venue. We support your journey with a fairer, lower fee structure that keeps your margins high from start to finish.
feature2.bullet1: Share your event page anywhere — social, email, your website
feature2.bullet2: Industry-lowest fees so you keep more of every sale
feature2.bullet3: Real-time dashboard to track revenue and sales

feature3.title: Powerful tools for expert event management
feature3.desc: Get all the tools you need to launch, manage, and scale your events effortlessly. With built-in analytics, tracking your ticket sales and understanding your audience has never been simpler.
feature3.bullet1: Check in guests with QR code scanning
feature3.bullet2: Handle refunds, cancellations, and payment confirmations
feature3.bullet3: Add co-organizers and staff with custom permission levels

pricing.label: Lowest fees, guaranteed
pricing.title: Unbeatable pricing for every event.
pricing.desc: No contracts, setup fees, or monthly charges. With us, it's just a simple flat fee for every ticket sold — more money where it matters: your events.

support.label: Unmatched 24/7 support
support.title: We're here for you, always.
support.desc: Got a question at 2am before your big event? Our team is on hand around the clock to help you succeed, whatever it takes.

features.label: More than just ticketing
features.title: Everything you need to run amazing events.
features.desc: From QR check-in and attendee management to discount codes and real-time analytics — every feature to make your events unforgettable.
